mathematical_sources.title: Solving the Reachability Problem for Branching Vector Addition Systems via Semilinear Inductive Invariants
mathematical_sources.statement_contract: For every initialized BVAS S and semilinear Phi containing Reach(S), there is a semilinear inductive invariant I contained in Phi; formalize only with repairs R01-R11.

mathematical_sources.title: Bridging the Gap Between Plain VASS and Branching VASS
mathematical_sources.locator: Proposition 5; corrected Corollary 7 path through Lemma 6; Lemmas 8, 9, and 11; Theorem 12; Corollary 14
mathematical_sources.statement_contract: Amalgamate two hereditarily positive context families over one run; combine root-configuration comparison with ordered decorated-tree embedding for the wqo; obtain bounded branching depth, compile each bounded-depth reachability set to a VASS section, conclude every BVASS reachability set is a VASS section, and hence its intersection with a semilinear set is almost semilinear.
